name: ThumblifyAI
tagline: Create Thumbnails That Make People Click
verdictSummary: A basic AI thumbnail generator can be built quickly using existing image models, but recreating ThumblifyAI requires much more than connecting an image API. The product's advantage comes from specialized thumbnail-focused system prompts, AI workflows, creator-focused features, thumbnail inspiration, style matching, AI customization features, and continuous iteration around generating clickable YouTube thumbnails.
coreLoopDIY: Generate YouTube thumbnail concepts and images using AI models with custom prompts and creator-focused workflows.
whatYouLose: custom AI training and personalization features
whyPeopleStillPay: Creators are not only paying for AI image generation. The biggest value is creating high-quality thumbnails without needing to become prompt experts. After years of testing and optimization, ThumblifyAI's system prompts, AI workflows, and generation process are tuned specifically for creating catchy YouTube thumbnails. Users get a faster and more consistent path from video idea to thumbnail instead of spending hours experimenting with prompts, styles, and settings.
notes: AI thumbnail maker platform built for YouTube creators.
prompt:
Build me a complete AI YouTube thumbnail generator SaaS.

Requirements:

- Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS for the frontend.
- Use PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for database management.
- Use NextAuth.js for authentication with email/password login.
- Users should be able to create an account, log in, and access their personal dashboard.
- Use an AI image generation API for creating thumbnails.
- Use an LLM API for improving prompts and creating structured thumbnail generation inputs.
- Build a dashboard where users can:
  - enter video title
  - add thumbnail idea
  - write a custom image prompt
  - choose a thumbnail style
  - add creator inspiration/reference
- Allow users to generate thumbnails directly from their own prompts.
- Generate multiple thumbnail variations from a single prompt.
- Include predefined thumbnail styles:
  - talking head
  - educational
  - gaming
  - tech
  - business
  - viral/click-focused
- Include a thumbnail analysis feature where users can analyze existing thumbnails and extract visual elements, composition, style, and design patterns.
- Save all generated thumbnails to the user's account history.
- Store thumbnail metadata including prompt, title, style, creation date, and generated image URL.
- Create a personal gallery where users can view and download previous generations.
- Add user settings page for managing profile information.
- Use .env for API keys and database credentials.
- Add rate limiting per user to prevent abuse.
- Include README documentation explaining setup, authentication, database migration, and API configuration.
- No payments, subscriptions, teams, analytics, or social sharing features.
- Focus on building a polished creator-focused SaaS experience for generating YouTube thumbnails from custom prompts.
